jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
OVERVIEW

This position can be based out of San Francisco, New York, or remote (we accept candidates from the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, HI, IL, MA, MI, MN, MT, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, TN, TX, UT, WA, WI).

We're looking for Full-Stack Software Engineers who want to help businesses of any size move money worldwide. You will contribute to APIs, banking infrastructure and financial workflows that ensure our customers can adopt and scale with Modern Treasury.

Whereas most SaaS companies move data, we move money. Our systems must scale to high volumes, with high accuracy and high reliability. Engineers at Modern Treasury design thoughtful design APIs, implement resilient processes, and choose infrastructure that prioritizes fault tolerance and long-term maintainability over chasing latest trends.

Our application is powered by Ruby on Rails, Postgres, Redis and ParadeDB. As of today, we are on the latest version of each technology. Github and typical CI/CD automation is used for deployments to AWS. While engineers have specialties, engineers can easily contribute to all layers and components of the application without friction.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins—plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting— Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

$750T+ moves across the bank rails each year. However, despite this incredible volume, the technology powering these rails has not kept pace with digital transformation in other industries. With the significance and scale of this opportunity in mind, Dimitri, Matt, and Sam founded Modern Treasury in 2018 to support the world's largest industries and money movers. Today, the company has grown to serve companies in the economy's most important sectors, from real-estate, healthcare, and insurance, to education and financial services.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build end-to-end features individually or in small teams

  • Iterate and ship code frequently

  • Participate in maintenance and ownership of a core component

  • Learn the payments space and shape projects before development

  • Be mentored and eventually become a mentor

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Interested in full-stack development, including backend jobs, DBs and frontend UX

  • A history of collaborating with a team to ship a major feature

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails, React & Postgres

  • Experience with financial software for banks, credit card processing or cryptocurrencies.

  • Ability to thrive in autonomous, engineer driven environment

Modern Treasury is committed to equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate in any employment opportunities or practices based on an individual's race, color, creed, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), religion (all aspects of religious beliefs, observance or practice, including religious dress or grooming practices), marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry (including language use restrictions and possession of a driver’s license issued under California Vehicle Code section 12801.9), natural hair, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, medical condition (including cancer or a record or history of cancer, and genetic characteristics), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical condition), genetic information, sexual orientation, military and veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. It also prohibits unlawful discrimination based on the perception that anyone has any of those characteristics, or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics.

Modern Treasury participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
OVERVIEW

This position can be based out of San Francisco, New York, or remote (we accept candidates from the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, HI, IL, MA, MD, MI, MN, MT, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, TN, TX, UT, WA, WI).

Modern Treasury is expanding deeper into money movement. We’re building new products that will let customers move funds across both traditional rails and emerging technologies, including stablecoins. You’ll help design, deploy and operate the infrastructure that makes this possible.

This is a hands-on devops role with strong ownership over infrastructure architecture and platform automation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, platform engineering and security. You’ll define how Modern Treasury scales and operates our infrastructure, and guide teams toward cohesive architectural patterns.

You will set direction and build for infrastructure systems that support:

  • Multi-rail money movement

  • Real-time payment flows

  • Ledger-backed transaction processing

  • High-availability payment orchestration

This is a staff individual contributor role with broad influence across Product, Platform, and Infrastructure teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead architecture for AWS infrastructure, container orchestration, and CI/CD to support scalable payment systems

  • Standardize automation and infrastructure-as-code to provision, scale, and operate high-volume ledger and transaction platforms

  • Reduce operational overhead through tooling, streamlined workflows, and engineering standards uplift

  • Optimize performance, reliability, and observability across real-time and rails-specific infrastructure

  • Define service ownership and operational models, aligning platform and product teams on scalable rail architecture

  • Contribute to infrastructure and security strategy for new payment rails, including FBO structures, stablecoin integrations, and compliance-focused features

WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

Required

  • 8+ years in Devops, or infrastructure engineering

  • Strong track record of setting technical direction without direct authority

  • Experience building internal platforms that abstract complexity away from product teams

  • Strong experience with:

    • Designing and operating distributed systems

    • AWS infrastructure at scale

    • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)

    • CI/CD systems and automation pipelines

    • Containerized environments (Docker)

    • Observability and performance tuning for production systems

  • Experience with application and product security

  • Experience scaling systems that process high-volume workloads

  • Experience defining reliability standards and operational maturity models

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience architecting infrastructure for multiple payment rails simultaneously

  • Experience scaling systems that process high-volume financial or transactional workloads

  • Understanding of payment rail mechanics (ACH, wires, RTP, cards, etc.)

  • Familiarity with security and risk standards for money movement

  • Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term infrastructure strategy

TECHNOLOGIES WE USE

  • Ruby on Rails for our backend

  • React, GraphQL, and Tailwind CSS on the front end

  • Postgres for our database

  • AWS for infrastructure and hosting

  • Docker for containerization

  • GitHub for source code management

  • Buildkite for continuous integration

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins—plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting—Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
OVERVIEW

Modern Treasury is hiring Account Executives to join our Sales team. While we've been in business for eight years and have powered over $400 billion in payments for hundreds of organizations, our PSP product is a newer motion — and we're looking for people to help us scale it and close the strong inbound demand we're seeing.

 

This is a high-volume closing role with real depth: you’ll run a large, fast-moving pipeline of new opportunities. While many deals move quickly, others call for a more strategic, consultative sell. We’re looking for AEs who can do both. Success in this role looks like consistently converting qualified opportunities into new logos.

 

You’ll sell primarily to founders, CTOs, and heads of product. You should be excited to develop deep product fluency, so you can be comfortable selling a technical, API-first product. You’ll own your pipeline end to end, guiding prospects from first conversation to live customer, and partner with Sales Engineers on the technical evaluation. You’ll also drive expansions and cross-sells across our existing customers.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins—plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting—Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 1+ years of Sales experience in closing deals

  • Bonus: experience selling a payments product, or working with stablecoins

  • Superior verbal and written communication, presentation and relationship management skills

  • Ability to thrive in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

  • BA/BS required

During your first week you will:

  • Meet the team and onboard onto the sales tools

  • Develop an understanding of the payments landscape

  • Build an understanding of how companies use Modern Treasury

During your first 4 weeks you will:

  • Build a deep understanding of our brand positioning, sales process, and customer stories

  • Shadow sales calls and listen to pre-recorded sales calls

  • Review proposals and supporting resources you can use during the sales cycle

  • Run your first sales calls

  • Build your pipeline

During your first 12 weeks you will:

  • Independently manage and develop your pipeline

  • Close your first customers

  • Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and improve our sales process

  • Communicate customer needs and requirements to Product and Marketing teams to inform our product roadmap

Modern Treasury is committed to equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate in any employment opportunities or practices based on an individual's race, color, creed, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), religion (all aspects of religious beliefs, observance or practice, including religious dress or grooming practices), marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry (including language use restrictions and possession of a driver’s license issued under California Vehicle Code section 12801.9), natural hair, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, medical condition (including cancer or a record or history of cancer, and genetic characteristics), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical condition), genetic information, sexual orientation, military and veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. It also prohibits unlawful discrimination based on the perception that anyone has any of those characteristics, or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics.

Modern Treasury participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Payments
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This position can be based out of San Francisco or New York.

OVERVIEW

Modern Treasury is hiring a Product Manager to help build and grow our Payments product. Payments enables companies to move money across the world. You will own core capabilities like how businesses get onboarded, verify identity, meet compliance requirements, access payment rails, and manage liquidity over fiat and stablecoin, all through Modern Treasury. You’ll bring products to life using advanced AI tools and leading engineering and customer-facing teams.

As a Product Manager on Payments, you will work with engineering, compliance, partnerships, and customer-facing teams to ship the infrastructure that powers payments for some of the largest and fastest-growing companies in the economy. Modern Treasury is often the most critical piece of infrastructure our customers use, and the Payments product sits at the center of how money actually moves.

We are looking for someone who has built payments products before and is excited to go deep on the full lifecycle of money movement — from a customer's first onboarding moment through real-time payments at scale, across both US and international rails.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins—plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting—Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Payments Product Manager, you will own products that make up Modern Treasury's Payments offering. You will leverage AI where possible and push the envelope of what AI-enabled product execution looks like. You will be responsible for researching, designing, and delivering products related to:

  • Onboarding & Compliance: You will help manage the experience of getting customers and their end users onto the platform quickly and safely. You will design onboarding flows that reduce time-to-first-payment while meeting the requirements of banks, partners, and regulators. You will also work closely with our compliance and risk teams to translate KYC, KYB, sanctions, and other regulatory requirements into product.

  • Payment rails: You will go deep into the design of the rails that power payments — domestic schemes like ACH, wire, and RTP, international and cross-border rails, and emerging options including stablecoins. You will prioritize which rails to add and how to expose them in a unified, reliable way. You will also work with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure reliability and good support in cases of incidents.

  • Liquidity: You will help define how funds are funded, held, and moved so that customers can settle payments efficiently. You will work on the product capabilities that give customers visibility and control over balances and liquidity across accounts and rails. In this role, you’ll interface with existing bank partners and stablecoin partners, and help scale the Payments across geographies.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • AI Fluency: You will help build and run AI-native workflows across the business. This is a hands-on, business-first role: you will identify inefficiencies, scope solutions, and use the best AI tools available to create compounding leverage for the team. You do not need to train models, but you should be fluent in applying modern AI tools to real business problems.

  • Payments experience: You have built payments products before and are familiar with both US and international payments. You understand how rails work end to end and what it takes to move money reliably at scale.

  • Cross-border expertise: Ideally, you have experience with both US and international cross-border payment rails, and you understand the operational and regulatory realities of moving money across borders.

  • Interest in or experience with stablecoins: You have experience with, or a strong interest in, stablecoins. You’ve studied how they work, and have opinions about how they fit into the future of global money movement.

  • Technical fluency: You relish going deep with engineers on the details of payment systems. You are technical-literate — you can read API docs and bank or scheme specs — and you are comfortable diving into data, including SQL, while knowing when not to.

  • Customer obsession: You want to spend a ton of time with customers and prospects, understanding their business models, flows of funds, and the support they need. You can translate those needs into clear engineering requirements.

  • Ownership at scale: You have a track record of shipping and iterating on products and are comfortable with a dynamic, responsive roadmap driven by the demands of customers and partners. You can work across compliance, partnerships, sales, and customer success to deliver.

Modern Treasury is committed to equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate in any employment opportunities or practices based on an individual's race, color, creed, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), religion (all aspects of religious beliefs, observance or practice, including religious dress or grooming practices), marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry (including language use restrictions and possession of a driver’s license issued under California Vehicle Code section 12801.9), natural hair, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, medical condition (including cancer or a record or history of cancer, and genetic characteristics), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical condition), genetic information, sexual orientation, military and veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. It also prohibits unlawful discrimination based on the perception that anyone has any of those characteristics, or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics.

Modern Treasury participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Head of Risk
jobs.descriptionHtml:
OVERVIEW

Modern Treasury is hiring a Head of Risk to build our risk function from the ground up. Money moves through Modern Treasury for some of the largest and fastest-growing companies in the economy. How well we manage the risk in that movement directly shapes the product — who we can onboard, how fast they can transact, and how much friction they feel along the way.

This is a foundational, hands-on role. You will decide how customers are underwritten, how limits and reserves are set, how transactions are authorized, and how we detect fraud — and you will build those systems early, before scale forces the decisions for you.

This role reports to our General Counsel, who leads Legal, Compliance, and Risk.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins, plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting, Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will start as an individual contributor with the mandate to build. You will own:

  • Onboarding & underwriting: How we evaluate customers before they move money with us — what we need to know to say yes, what conditions we attach, and how to reach that decision fast enough that it isn't the reason a customer picks someone else. You will partner with Compliance on KYB while owning the underwriting judgment beside it.

  • Transaction risk & limits: How we authorize money movement in real time, and how limits flex as we learn more about a business. This includes the hard cases — managing dynamic limits when a few customers drive most of the volume, and loosening constraints on good customers as fast as the data allows.

  • Reserves & exposure: Reserve policy and our view of loss exposure across ACH returns, unauthorized debits, and counterparty failure. You will quantify what we're exposed to, decide what's worth taking, and make that reasoning legible to the rest of the company.

  • Detection & the risk engine: The machinery. You will select and deploy the tooling — vendor, in-house, or both — that turns policy into automated decisions, and use modern AI tooling to automate case handling rather than staffing your way out of the problem.

  • New rails, stablecoins & wallet controls: The emerging surface area. You will help Modern Treasury expand into stablecoins, wallets, RfP, and local rails in other countries safely — understanding the risks unique to each rail, partnering with Product on controls that are both safe and usable, and designing for new money-movement patterns before they become edge cases at scale.

You will work across Engineering, Product, Compliance, Finance, and our customer-facing teams, and make sure risk and compliance run on one coherent set of systems rather than two stacks that disagree.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You've built this before: You've stood up a risk function at an early-stage or high-growth company rather than inherited a mature one. You know what the first version looks like, what to defer, and what will hurt in eighteen months if you skip it now.

  • Payments risk, specifically: Not lending or credit. You understand ACH returns, settlement timing, unauthorized debit exposure, and counterparty risk. You know the difference between risk and compliance, and where they have to work as one.

  • Curiosity about new rails: Stablecoin, wallet, RfP, or international local-rail experience is a strong plus. More importantly, you are interested in learning unfamiliar rails quickly and translating their unique risks into practical product and operational controls.

  • A systems thinker, not a queue operator: You think about decisioning at scale and design for an order of magnitude more volume. You'll set thresholds and review edge cases by hand when needed, but you're building toward something that doesn't require it.

  • Technical and data fluency: You can go deep with engineers and hold your own. You're comfortable in the data yourself — SQL, ideally Python — and fluent in applying modern AI tools to operational problems.

  • Scar tissue, earned well: You've seen things go wrong — a fraud ring, a loss event, a control that failed in a way nobody anticipated — and carry the pattern recognition that comes with it. You were in the room, not the cause.

  • Judgment you can defend: You'll make consequential calls with incomplete information and get some wrong. You reason clearly about tradeoffs, write your thinking down, and can explain why a decision was right even when the outcome wasn't.

  • Influence across the company: You'll often be telling people something they don't want to hear. You can make the case for risk investment in terms the rest of the business cares about.

  • Management experience is a plus: You may hire onto this team within the first year. You don't need to have run a large org, but you should have managed before and want to build a team over time.

jobs.title: Workplace Coordinator
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Modern Treasury is hiring a Workplace Coordinator to run the day-to-day operations of our SF headquarters, with oversight of our NY office as well. You'll own the physical workplace — space, vendors, supplies, and the daily standards that make the office a place people want to come to — while partnering closely with our onsite Executive Assistant on events, exec support, and VIP visits. This role reports to the Head of People Operations.

You thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment and are comfortable making decisions with the information you have, escalating when it matters. You care about the well-being of colleagues and guests, and you take pride in a space that's clean, organized, and running smoothly — even when no one's watching.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins — plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting — Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

WEEK BY WEEK

First Week

  • Onboard with the team and learn our core tools (GSuite, Notion, Slack, Brivo Access Control, Comelit and more).

  • Start learning our product and business.

  • Establish the daily rhythm of the office: a morning walkthrough to check that conference rooms are tidy and wiped down, whiteboards are cleared, and the kitchen is stocked and clean before the team arrives. Make the first pot of coffee. These small details set the tone for the whole day.

  • Be a visible, friendly, outcome-focused presence in the office daily — someone people know they can bring a problem to.

First Six Weeks

  • Coordinate office repairs and maintenance — HVAC, lighting, furniture, cleaning — and own the vendor relationships behind them (janitorial, culinary, supplies, preventative maintenance, safety, building management).

  • Take full ownership of day-to-day office standards, closing any gaps with cleaning and supply vendors so the space stays consistently polished and guest-ready.

  • Partner with our Executive Assistant on team events, happy hours, all-hands, and external onsite/offsite events — you handle space, setup, and vendor logistics; the EA leads exec and VIP coordination.

  • Own space planning for the SF and NY offices, including moves, adds, and changes. Conduct facility audits and building inspections to ensure standards are maintained across both locations.

  • Administer mail distribution, courier services, and confidential document handling with discretion.

  • Own the company swag program and manage sending out employee anniversary gifts.

  • Respond to workplace tickets and provide proactive support alongside the Workplace Technology team.

First Six Months

  • Be a driving force of office culture — an environment that feels uplifting, organized, and easy to work in.

  • Be willing to stay late or arrive early to support after-hours events, ensuring the space is set up, stocked, and reset afterward.

  • Keep the Workplace budget on target and projects delivered on time.

  • Gather feedback from employees and continuously improve Workplace systems and programs.

  • Take ownership of additional Workplace projects as they come up.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 2+ years of administrative, workplace, or operations experience.

  • 5 days per week in office, 8:30am to 5pm.

  • Proactive, positive, and pragmatic — able to think strategically and execute tactically.

  • Comfortable with occasional early mornings or evenings to support events.

jobs.title: CFO/VP of Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
OVERVIEW

Modern Treasury is hiring a finance leader to shape the company’s next phase of growth. This is a strategic role with broad influence across the business.

This person will partner closely with the CEO and management team on company strategy, organizational design, and resource allocation. They will play a key role in building and scaling Modern Treasury’s payments business, helping shape its business model, partner economics, pricing, and path to attractive long-term unit economics. More broadly, they will help determine where we invest our people and capital to create long-term company and shareholder value, while bringing a rigorous economic perspective to product, pricing, and strategic decisions.

They will also lead our approach to capital markets and strategic transactions, serve as a clear and credible partner to our Board and investors, and build and scale the finance organization, including defining how AI should transform the way the function operates.

This role reports to our CEO.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. We help teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins, plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting, Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Shape company and operating model: Partner with the CEO and management team on the decisions that determine how Modern Treasury is built and where it focuses. Help shape organizational structure, including teams, roles, and responsibilities.

  • Drive resource allocation and long-term value creation: Help determine where we should invest our people and capital to create the greatest long-term company and shareholder value.

  • Guide the economics of our product: Bring an economic lens to product strategy and roadmap decisions and pricing and packaging, including the expected value of new products and capabilities, investment tradeoffs, and build, buy, or partner decisions. Negotiate with financial partners and banks, and drive the economics that make our payments business work.

  • Lead capital markets and strategic transactions: Identify and consult on the best way to meet our capital needs. Lead primary capital raises, debt facilities, M&A and other strategic transactions, as needed.

  • Partner with the Board and key investors: Communicate Modern Treasury's financial performance, outlook, and strategy clearly and credibly. Help the board and investors understand both the company's near-term performance and long-term opportunity.

  • Lead and scale the finance function: Build and manage a high-performing team and scale it over time as the business becomes larger and more complex.

  • Set AI strategy for finance: Develop and implement a point of view on how AI can make the finance organization more effective, from how the team operates to the capabilities it can provide to the rest of the company.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You have a combination of strategic judgment, commercial instincts, and financial depth.

  • You think and act as a company builder and a driver (not a passenger).

  • You've navigated strategic transactions such as primary capital raises, debt financings, or M&A.

  • You're a strong communicator and storyteller who can represent the business clearly and credibly with boards, investors, and other external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Candidates must be comfortable working standard business hours aligned with the Pacific Time Zone.

 

OVERVIEW

Modern Treasury is hiring a Technical Support Specialist to investigate, triage, and resolve issues for the customers running payments on our platform.

This role reports to the Manager of Customer Support and sits at the intersection of our customers, our products, and our engineering teams. Nuanced investigations across APIs, bank and network reporting, ledger balances, and onchain settlement mean the work is rarely repetitive. You will have agency in your day to day, and your findings will directly shape product and process decisions.

Modern Treasury leverages AI heavily. This role is best suited for someone who is already using AI tools and is eager to continue pushing the envelope on AI best practices.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins — plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting — Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Resolve Customer Issues with Technical Depth

  • Establish deep expertise in money movement fundamentals and Modern Treasury's core products, including the nuanced dependencies between them

  • Investigate and resolve issues reported by internal and external customers within our stated SLAs

  • Support customers across payment programs, covering payment limits and rejections, legal entity and KYC/KYB onboarding, settlement timing, and stablecoin and fiat rail behavior, while routing risk, compliance, and commercial questions to the right owners

Own Incidents and Reconciliation

  • Participate in a 24/7 response team covering incidents and high-priority requests from premium support customers, including time-sensitive escalations outside business hours

  • Work with Engineering and Product teams through identification, response, and retrospective to find root causes and drive changes that prevent recurrence

  • Investigate changes in bank and network reporting, manually reconcile objects, improve reconciliation logic, and give feedback to internal teams in order to improve processes.

Scale Processes and Impact

  • Identify gaps and build the policies, procedures, and performance standards that let Support scale with growth

  • Use data-driven methods to surface customer and product trends, and bring recommendations to cross-functional teams

  • Use AI tools to accelerate investigation, synthesize patterns across the queue, and build repeatable workflows

WHO YOU ARE

Minimum Requirements:

  • 4+ years in customer-facing technical roles at B2B SaaS companies, in functions such as technical support, customer success, sales engineering, product management, engineering, or network operations

  • Experience with REST APIs and integration protocols including JSON/XML, FTP/FTPS/SFTP, and API concepts such as idempotency and pagination

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot issues in production environments

  • Excellent written communication, especially in async channels like email and Slack

  • Experience using AI agents in a work environment

  • Comfortable working standard business hours aligned with Pacific Time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background in payments, fintech, or financial systems, especially PSP, marketplace, or embedded payments models

  • Familiarity with stablecoin settlement, ledgering, and reconciliation workflows

  • Experience with SQL and observability or BI tools such as Hex, Datadog, and Sentry

  • Experience in process improvement and change management

  • Familiarity with Pylon or AI-native support tools

We welcome candidates who don't meet every requirement above but demonstrate strong technical aptitude and a genuine passion for learning.

 
 

Modern Treasury is committed to equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate in any employment opportunities or practices based on an individual's race, color, creed, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), religion (all aspects of religious beliefs, observance or practice, including religious dress or grooming practices), marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry (including language use restrictions and possession of a driver’s license issued under California Vehicle Code section 12801.9), natural hair, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, medical condition (including cancer or a record or history of cancer, and genetic characteristics), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical condition), genetic information, sexual orientation, military and veteran status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. It also prohibits unlawful discrimination based on the perception that anyone has any of those characteristics, or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics.

Modern Treasury participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
